data.report: Monday, November 21, 2026 9:00 AM – Monday brings sunny skies and light winds, with temperatures starting in the teens before climbing into the low 30s. 19 lifts are open, conditions permitting. Expect settled packed powder and fresh corduroy across groomed runs, with firm and fast conditions early before sunny slopes soften slightly through the afternoon. Exposed terrain up high will hold some wind-packed snow. For a smooth first carve, head down Saddle Bowl off Face Lift Express (3) while the corduroy is still crisp. Conditions and Visibility: Mostly sunny skies with a few passing clouds around midday, light winds and cool temperatures. Expect packed powder and groomed corduroy across the mountain, with firmer conditions early and a slight softening on sunny aspects through the afternoon. Exposed areas may hold wind-packed snow. Lift Status: 19 lifts are open, conditions permitting. Safety: Be aware of early-season obstacles that may still be hidden beneath the snow. Conditions aren't quite like peak season just yet, so stick to open, groomed trails and ride within your ability level . Give other skiers and riders plenty of room, especially when passing on firm, fast groomers. There is no uphill skiing or skinning access anywhere on the resort . Visit our Safety page for more tips. Our on-mountain emergency hotline is 760.934.0611. Road Conditions: Always be prepared for winter mountain driving and watch for icy patches, especially in shaded areas. Check our Road Conditions page for the latest updates.
